## How Does Your Website Become a Live App?


Paste your website URL into the prompt at[taskade.com/create](https://www.taskade.com/create) . Taskade EVE reads the page, understands your business, and uses it as the brief for a live Taskade Genesis app. The design, the copy, and the offer on your homepage become the starting point, so you describe what to build on top of it instead of describing the business from scratch.


That order matters. Most builders start you at an empty prompt and ask you to describe a business that is already described on your homepage. Here the homepage is the description. Taskade EVE starts from what you have and builds forward.


What you bring What happens to it


Your website URL, in the prompt Taskade EVE reads the page and understands your business, then builds the app


A web page or video URL, in Media Files Choose **Import** , paste the link, and it is saved as a media item


A saved page, video, or document Choose **Create project** to turn it into a Taskade project


Any of the above Add it to an AI agent as knowledge, so the agent answers from it


Once the app is live, the workspace fills in around it. Add data projects to hold your records. Save your pages, videos, PDFs, and documents to Media Files, turn the ones you need into projects, and train and embed[AI agents](https://www.taskade.com/agents) on them, so the app can answer questions and update records. Then automate the follow-up, so the work keeps moving after you close the tab. The step-by-step for every import path lives in[Learn: Import](https://www.taskade.com/learn/import) , and[Learn: Agent Knowledge](https://www.taskade.com/learn/agents/knowledge) shows how to train an agent on what you brought in.


## What Do You Get When You Clone an App Kit?


You get the whole stack. Cloning an App Kit brings the app, its projects, its agents, and its automations into your workspace together, already connected. Pick a kit in the[Community Gallery](https://www.taskade.com/apps) , clone it, swap in your business, and keep going.


Broker Calendar, Finance Tracker, and Simple Store are three of the live kits you can clone today, and the gallery holds CRMs, portals, stores, trackers, and more.


What cloning brings over Why it matters


The app Live from the first minute, with its pages and screens intact


The projects The records the app reads and writes, already in place


The agents The AI teammates behind the app, ready to train on your knowledge


The automations The follow-up steps, already wired to the app and the projects


Paste your site when the front of the business already exists online. Clone a kit when the system already exists and you would rather make it yours. Either way you land in the same workspace, with the same parts connected.


## How Do You Connect the Work and Let It Run?


Connect projects, embed AI agents, and enable automations, and your app can remember, think, and take action. Forms, chat, bookings, email, calendars, and tools work together, and the[automations](https://www.taskade.com/automate) keep running 24/7, powered by your Workspace DNA.


The loop is short, and it repeats without you:


- **A customer asks.** Forms, chatbots, and submissions hit your app.
- **An agent responds.** It answers from the knowledge you trained it on and updates the record.
- **An automation executes.** Emails, calendars, and tools stay connected, and the next step starts.


Every automation begins with a trigger, and[Learn: Automation Triggers](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/triggers) lists what can start one, from a form submission to a change in a project. From there the automation can reach any of the 100+ integrations Taskade connects to.


## What Is Workspace DNA?


Workspace DNA is the loop that keeps your files, your app, and the work behind it in one workspace. Memory holds what you brought in, Intelligence reasons over it, and Execution moves it along. Because each part feeds the next, the result of one task becomes the memory the next task uses.


Four parts, one workspace:


- **Projects remember.** Your projects, your Media Files, your apps, and your agents share one memory.
- **Agents reason.** Custom agent teams, trained on your knowledge.
- **Workflows run.** Automations connect email, calendar, and tools.
- **Apps serve.** Live portals, shops, and dashboards for your customers.


Taskade EVE builds all of it together.[Learn: Workspace DNA](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/workspace-dna) explains how the three parts feed each other.


## Start With What You Already Have


The fastest way in is the thing you already own. If your business has a website, paste the URL into[Taskade Genesis](https://www.taskade.com/create) and let Taskade EVE build the app from it. If your business looks like a kit that is already running, open the[Community Gallery](https://www.taskade.com/apps) and clone it. Then add the projects, the agents, and the automations, and let the work run.


[Paste your website →](https://www.taskade.com/create) or[browse App Kits →](https://www.taskade.com/apps)


## Frequently Asked Questions


Can I turn my existing website into a Taskade app?


Yes. Paste your website URL into the prompt at[taskade.com/create](https://www.taskade.com/create) . Taskade EVE reads the page, understands your business, and builds a live Taskade Genesis app from it.


Can I save a web page or a video to my workspace?


Yes. Open Media Files, choose **Import** , and paste the URL. Then choose **Create project** on the saved item, or add it to an AI agent as knowledge. Uploaded PDFs and documents take the same path.


What do I add after the website becomes an app?


Data projects to hold your records,[AI agents](https://www.taskade.com/agents) trained on your knowledge, and[automations](https://www.taskade.com/automate) that carry the follow-up.


What is an App Kit in Taskade?


A live Taskade Genesis app you can clone into your workspace with its projects, agents, and automations connected. Broker Calendar, Finance Tracker, and Simple Store are three of the kits in the[Community Gallery](https://www.taskade.com/apps) .


Should I paste my website or clone an App Kit?


Paste your website when the front of the business already exists online. Clone an App Kit when you want a system that is already running. Both land in the same workspace.


What can the automations connect to?


Forms, chat, bookings, email, calendars, and the tools you already use. See[Learn: Automation Triggers](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/triggers) for what can start one.


What is Workspace DNA?


The loop that keeps your files, app, and work in one workspace: projects remember, agents reason, workflows run, and apps serve. See[Learn: Workspace DNA](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/workspace-dna) .


Where can I learn how to import content into Taskade?


The[Import section of Learn Taskade](https://www.taskade.com/learn/import) covers every import path, and[Learn: Agent Knowledge](https://www.taskade.com/learn/agents/knowledge) shows how to train an agent on what you brought in.
